title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in the Kambia, Karene and Port Loko districts of Sierra Leone, works towards the goal that individuals and communities affected by crisis, transition from reliance on relief towards independence. This objective focuses on communities adopting measures and approaches, which strengthen their resilience to cope with crises and shocks. Activities include capacity strengthening activities in line with international humanitarian standards; strengthening disaster risk reduction processes; supporting coordination mechanisms at district and national level. The principle focus of this outcome is:
Strengthening disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have
Strengthening existing coordination mechanisms in preparation for future emergency response
